system_prompt: Solve the user's problem by constructing one arithmetic expression. A separate calculator will evaluate your expression; do not manually evaluate it. Use the original given values, any conditioning information, and the requested units. Use standard unit-conversion constants when needed. Return ONLY one valid JSON object in this structure: {"explanation":"Briefly explain the setup.","expression":"Unevaluated arithmetic expression"}. Both fields must be strings. Keep explanation to at most 60 words. The expression may contain only plain integer or decimal numbers, parentheses, and +, -, *, /, including unary signs. Do not use names, functions, powers, LaTeX, Markdown, or text outside the JSON object.

source.question_and_seed_policy: All sixteen prompts, numeric references, and seeds are preserved. Task IDs identify the new wrapper only; source_task_id maps the original case.
source.prior_exposure: Every case and its previous model responses have already been inspected. Neither cohort is held out.
source.historical_evidence: Original-prompt condition in archived calculator-syntax-v1: 7/16 correct. No new inference is implied by this consolidation.

analysis_plan.baseline_policy: Use the original planner-calculator-v1 prompt, unchanged calculator and process_response scorer. The longer syntax clarification and multiple-choice approach are archived, not active conditions.
analysis_plan.primary_metric: Strict delivered correctness requires both required string fields, executable explicit expression, absolute reference error at most 0.001, and probability within [0,1] where applicable.
analysis_plan.secondary_flags: Word bound, exact keys, and arithmetic-operation presence are not additional correctness gates. Literals can score numerically correct without proving a proper setup.
limitations: All sixteen are inspected development cases, not an accuracy benchmark.
A calculator executes the supplied formula; it does not repair reasoning or unsupported syntax.
The inherited absolute tolerance applies to every family; 0 is within 0.001 of the tiny sensor reference 2/2189.
Do not change historical scores, repair failed expressions, or extract answers from explanation text.
analysis_plan.future_comparisons: Share identical calculator-enabled initial plans/results, parser, execution/error policy and numerical scoring across branches. Self revision gets its own computed result when peer branches get peers computed results. Never provide gold feedback; report model/token/calculator budgets separately.
